claims.claim: Severity: not stated

claims.claim: Fixed in: not applicable, hosted service; no customer steps beyond stopgap
claims.quote: OpenRouter post gives no specific customer steps; ZDR restored only after 'appropriate assurances and validation'. Together: commit reverted after automated scanning detected it.
